summary: Mutation MUT-9: Reversed iteration direction in Acl::checkAccess from forward (begin→end) to backward (rbegin→rend). This changes first-match semantics to last-match semantics for overlapping subnets. All 3 test binaries (test_acl, test_acl_longest_match, test_acl_query) pass because they only use non-overlapping subnets where iteration direction is irrelevant. The mutation survives due to a test coverage gap: no existing test exercises checkAccess with overlapping subnets where first-match vs last-match would produce different results. The separate findMostSpecificMatch method (which correctly handles overlaps via longest-prefix matching) is not affected by this mutation.
